_comment: escher_14b_480p workload spec. Shapes are parameterized; calibrate to match the PDF op-table totals (4641.7 GFLOPs / 3070.2 MB HBM per block). Default is a notional ~14B DiT at 480p with image+text conditioning.
name: escher_14b_480p

model._calibration_note: These shapes were tuned to land per-block totals within a few percent of the PDF reference (4641.7 GFLOPs / 3070.2 MB HBM). If your real escher_14b_480p uses different shapes, edit this block and re-run benchmarks/bench04_workload_ops.py — the `calibration_drift` field in ops.json must be |drift| < 5% before the campaign signs off.

reference_totals_per_block._note: Per the PDF op table. If your shape/depth produce totals more than 5% off, recalibrate the shape spec before signing off the campaign.
